newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's car output rises 11.35 pct in '96 - Anfavea.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's car output rises 11.35 pct in '96 - Anfavea.

text.p: Brazilian car output rose 11.35 percent to 1,813,881 vehicles in 1996, up from 1,629,008 vehicles manufactured in 1995, the Motor Manufacturers Association (Anfavea) said in a report.
Production of vehicles in Brazil in December rose 22.13 percent to 132,472 vehicles compared with 108,466 vehicles in December 1995, Anfavea said.
The industry group said domestic car sales reached 1,506,784 vehicles in 1996, a hike of 10.85 percent over 1995, when 1,359,332 vehicles were sold in the domestic market.
